verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say the Terminal SDKs and the server-driven integration include a built-in simulated card reader, so developers can build and test without physical hardware. They also explicitly recommend testing with the reader simulator before ordering a reader. The Stripe CLI is documented as a general tool for testing Stripe integrations. Missing for 10: detail on simulated test cards and end-to-end test scenarios (e.g., declines, offline flows), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the simulator.
